The necklace features large, textured beads in various colors (pink, blue, purple, red) that appear to be wrapped in thread or yarn. A large, heart-shaped pendant with similar multicolored thread-wrapped texture hangs at the center bottom. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.

To confirm the object is classified as a necklace and distinguish the specific type (beaded/thread-wrapped) from other jewelry classes.

To verify the physical connectivity of the beads. AI often fails to render the thin strings connecting heavy beads, leading to floating objects. This expert will check if the beads form a single connected component.
To assess the overall realism of the textures (thread vs. plastic) and identify any subtle generative artifacts like melting or inconsistent lighting on the mannequin.
